# orion suggestions

List, apply, or dismiss group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestions <command> [options]
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `--json` | Print JSON  |

## orion suggestions apply

Apply group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestions apply [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument   | Description            |
| ---------- | ---------------------- |
| `[ids...]` | Suggestion ids         |
| `--all`    | Apply every suggestion |

## orion suggestions dismiss

Dismiss group suggestions

```sh
orion suggestions dismiss [options] [ids...]
```

| Argument   | Description              |
| ---------- | ------------------------ |
| `[ids...]` | Suggestion ids           |
| `--all`    | Dismiss every suggestion |
